status: Demonstrated improvement promoted; requested OT target not met
summary: Promote hold-for-last-shot plus two-point shot preference in modern NBA games. NBA OT rises from 3.24% to 4.10%; mean margin changes from 13.15 to 13.13; the 20+ rate changes from 22.18% to 22.80%. The requested 4.5–5.5% OT target is NOT reached. WNBA and pre-2020 games retain Phase 10 behavior.
scope: NBA/male league, season 2020 onward. Five-season calibration uses 2025 fictional NBA universes; this is not statistical calibration of every historical era.
rejectedArms: Expanded/repeated intentional fouling: corrected adverse outcome and no broad benefit.
Timeout advance: no convincing corrected benefit, incomplete court/timeout representation.
Global/WNBA hold+quick deployment: five WNBA seasons show lowerOT and increased margins/blowouts.
acceptedMechanics: When tied with more than 4 and at most 24 seconds left, and enough shot clock, wait until 4 seconds remain to initiate the final action. Ordinary shot, foul and turnover mechanics remain.
When down two within 30 seconds, inside-shot weight is multiplied by 1.3 and three-point weight by 0.7. This is shot preference, not an accuracy or clock-speed boost.
schemaChanges: None; transient possession context only. Existing completed games are unchanged.
limitations: Final-minute possession starts remain lower and durations longer than the small real PBP sample. No universal clock-speed multiplier applied.
Margin preservation is within declared point-estimate tolerances, not statistical proof of equivalence.
Same retained five season seeds, not an independent holdout sample.
WNBA candidate rejected; its old engine remains.
